title: Variable-speed cooling tower power and low-load controls

design_fan_power_w.description: Explicit total tower electrical watts at design airflow, or explicit Autosize. Autosized design airflow depends on this power; not per-cell watts or motor horsepower.

minimum_air_flow_ratio.description: Explicit fan-on minimum airflow ratio, not a minimum hourly average or direct minimum fan power.

free_convection_capacity_fraction.description: Explicit fraction of current full-speed heat rejection available with fan off; manufacturer/performance assumption, not annual free-cooling fraction.
